recipes.name: Bandage
recipes.description: A sterile splint and wooden fiber wrapping. Cleanses and cures the Bleed status effect.

recipes.name: Antidote
recipes.description: A concentrated herbal extract that neutralizes venom. Cleanses and cures the persistent Poison status effect.

recipes.name: Energy Potion
recipes.description: A potent herbal tonic. Instantly restores 35 Energy, grants +2 Energy/s for 15s, and accelerates Energy Regen skill growth.

recipes.name: Health Potion
recipes.description: A restorative herbal draft brewed from wild herbs. Instantly restores health, filling Critical HP before Main HP.

recipes.name: Mana Potion
recipes.description: An infused distillation of ethereal ectoplasm and wild herbs. Instantly restores 35 Energy/Mana, grants +2 Energy/s for 15s, and accelerates Mana Regen skill growth.

recipes.name: Bone Meal
recipes.description: Finely crushed monster bones. Used as a vital chemical reagent in potent restoratives and agricultural compounds.

recipes.name: Revive Potion
recipes.description: A potent revitalizing elixir brewed from bone meal and wild herbs. Channel for 3 seconds to revive a fallen ally to 50% HP.

recipes.name: Escape Stone
recipes.description: [PLACEHOLDER COST - Alpha Balancing Required] A resonating dimensional stone. Teleports the entire party back to the Outpost when out of combat, ending the dungeon run safely with all loot preserved.
recipes._comment: PLACEHOLDER COST - Alpha Balancing Required: During active development, cost is kept at 1 wood for test convenience. Real alpha balancing will require expensive ingredients (e.g. rare dungeon essence/ingot) so as not to undermine one-way portal risk.

recipes.name: Burn Salve
recipes.description: Herbal salve that immediately soothes and cures burn status.

recipes.name: Eyewash
recipes.description: Purifying rinse that restores sight and cures blind status.

recipes.name: Swiftness Draught
recipes.description: Light, effervescent draught that relieves sluggishness and cures slow status.

recipes.name: Warming Draught
recipes.description: Spicy, warming potion that thaws the blood and cures frostbite status.

recipes.name: Clarity Draught
recipes.description: A crystalline tonic that clears cognitive fog and cures confusion.

recipes.name: Paralysis Cure
recipes.description: An energizing antidote that jump-starts paralyzed nerves and cures paralysis.

recipes.name: Venom Coating
recipes.description: Distilled toxic venom that coats weapons, granting a 25% chance to inflict poison on hit.

recipes.name: Searing Coating
recipes.description: Blazing alchemical oil that coats weapons, granting a 20% chance to inflict burn on hit.

recipes.name: Paralytic Coating
recipes.description: Electrified neurotoxin coating that grants a 15% chance to inflict paralysis on hit.

recipes.name: Sand Pouch
recipes.description: A pocket of coarse grit thrown at enemies to blind all foes in a 1-tile area.

recipes.name: Fire Bomb
recipes.description: Incendiary bomb dealing 18 damage and 100% burn across a 1.5-tile radius.

recipes.name: Frost Bomb
recipes.description: Cryogenic bomb dealing 14 damage and 100% slow across a 1.5-tile radius.

recipes.name: Thunder Bomb
recipes.description: Electrified bomb dealing 14 damage and 50% paralysis across a 1.5-tile radius.

recipes.name: Bewildering Powder
recipes.description: Enchanted dust cloud that confuses all enemies within a 1.5-tile radius (60% chance).
